findings.text: this module and tests/test_moment_path_separatrix_test.py build _FluxSelectedProfile inputs and therefore reach the branch clip_quadrature.py:902 changes, but neither was run in the gate, so the floor was not exercised against their expectations; the recorded suites cover tests/test_exact_clip_moments.py and tests/test_exact_clip_seed.py only, and no added failure could have been observed in the modules that do reach the change.

the landing record states the repair while the done-when's terminal census is unmeasured, so a reader of the section sees a landed fix without the observation it was dispatched to make; the record does name the refusal and withholds the verdict.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base e2edd8775bff; one production line at clip_quadrature.py:902 plus a comment, a 160-line test, gate scripts, receipts and a cumulative landing-record append, with no rewrite of peer evidence.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when has three clauses; the code floor and the two-cell fixture with an inherited capacity of one and a finite-moment assertion are met and recorded, and the third (one all_debug census at the weak 135-cell terminal state reporting zero overflowing bank signatures and a finite exact total, log committed under docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/exact-bank-capacity/) was not produced, because the census stops before current integration on the out-of-scope _partition_probe state slicing.
item_verdicts.goal: the reviewed node's goal is the callback capacity floor, and nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py:902 raises the bank to max(inherited capacity, leading dimension of support.support_vertices), which is the clause stated verbatim in the dispatch GOAL line; the production caller forward_operator._cell_banked_current_moments:344 passes cut_cell_capacity=1 into the whole-cell branch, which is the value the fixture crosses.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states 3 passed in 25.62 s for the new focused test and records the red control, the two fresh-process suites and the census refusal with logs named on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares six paths and the five commits touch only files inside them (git log --name-only e2edd8775bff..a435f0ccd), and the outside-fence consequence is disclosed under follow_ons rather than edited.

justifications.durability: the added assertion at tests/test_exact_bank_callback_capacity.py:156 reddens on the reinstated defect and I reproduced that red at revision 22acdbada with the fix absent, and the fixture is a two-cell support only, so the mesh-sized floor's behaviour at the production cell counts the platform refuses to compile is unmeasured.
justifications.evidence: the red and green receipts exist and I reproduced the red independently, but the done-when's third clause was never measured, so the receipt for the 135-cell terminal state the defect was observed on does not exist and the census exited 1 before current integration.
justifications.fit: the floor is a single max() at the callback head with a comment stating why the re-derived level can mark more cells than the caller sized for, and it changes no name or signature.
justifications.goal_fidelity: clip_quadrature.py:902 floors the callback capacity at the leading dimension of support.support_vertices, which is exactly the clause the dispatch GOAL line states and it is the callback entry the terminal-state overflow was traced to.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in e2edd8775bff..a435f0ccd lies inside the six declared write paths, the one out-of-scope dependency is reported under follow_ons in the manifest rather than edited, and the landing record is appended, not rewritten.
